subject: Commercial onboarding | billing & procurement acceptance checklist
messages:
From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
To: Anita Shah <anita.shah@cloudwave.com>, Tom Reyes <tom.reyes@cloudwave.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 15 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Commercial onboarding | billing & procurement acceptance checklist

Hi Anita / Tom,

Great to talk earlier — thanks for carving out the time. Quick recap from our side and a couple of asks so we can scope the onboarding timeline: 

What we heard you need (procurement & billing):
- Preferred purchase route: PO issued from CloudWave AP (vs. credit card)
- Payment terms: typically net 45 for enterprise contracts (we discussed net 30 vs net 45)
- Invoice format: PDF with line-level breakdown, tax/VAT separate, PO number field, we also noted they might require a specific billing address format
- Tax: CloudWave is VAT-registered in the UK; they need VAT ID and tax-exempt fields handled where applicable
- Additional: PO routing to AP@cloudwave.com and separate contact for invoicing (Anita)

Can you confirm the following so we can align with billing ops and legal?
1) Final payment terms (net 30 / net 45 / other)
2) Billing address and exact invoice recipient name and email for PO attachment
3) Whether CloudWave needs vendor W-9 / W-8BEN or equivalent tax docs on file
4) Any required invoice fields beyond PO, line items, tax, total (e.g., project code, cost center)

We can produce an "Invoice spec" PDF and a PO template that matches your AP intake. I attached a quick first-draft spec (see Redwood-Invoice-Specs-v1.pdf). Once you confirm, Marissa will route to our billing ops to set up the vendor and agree on invoicing cadence.

Next steps proposed:
- You confirm items 1–4 by Wed 11/18
- We produce final invoice template + test invoice by Fri 11/20
- Test invoice sent to AP for ingestion and confirmation the format is accepted

Thanks —
Marcus Lin
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marcus.lin@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0139

Attachment: Redwood-Invoice-Specs-v1.pdf (1 page)
From: Anita Shah <anita.shah@cloudwave.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
Cc: Tom Reyes <tom.reyes@cloudwave.com>
Date: Mon, 16 Nov 2026 11:34:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Commercial onboarding | billing & procurement acceptance checklist

Marcus —

Thanks for the clear recap and the draft spec. Confirming from CloudWave AP side: 

1) Payment terms: net 45 (this is standard for us on multi-year SaaS contracts)
2) Billing recipient & address:
   - Bill To: CloudWave Holdings, Inc.
   - Attention: Accounts Payable
   - Address: 600 Harbor Drive, Suite 100, San Mateo, CA 94401
   - Email for invoices/POs: ap@cloudwave.com
   - PO contact: Anita Shah (anita.shah@cloudwave.com)
3) Tax docs: We need Redwood to provide the appropriate US tax form (W-9). For our international subsidiary invoices (EU VAT), we also require VAT registration number listed when applicable.
4) Required invoice fields: PO number (mandatory), line-item description, unit price, quantity, subtotal per line, tax/VAT line, total, Redwood vendor tax id, and our internal cost center (we'll provide after PO is generated).

A couple of notes:
- We can accept PDF invoices delivered to ap@cloudwave.com. Our AP system also consumes a CSV batch ingest for high-volume partners; if Redwood can provide a CSV sample later that would speed automation.
- We do prefer POs rather than credit card for any contract-level commitments.

If you can attach a W-9 and updated invoice spec with a PO field and vendor tax id, we can kick off vendor onboarding on our side.

Best,
Anita
Head of Procurement | CloudWave
anita.shah@cloudwave.com | +1 (650) 555-0199
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 16 Nov 2026 12:05:00 -0800
Subject: Fwd: Commercial onboarding | billing & procurement acceptance checklist

Quick internal note / tasks:

- AP intake: Anita confirmed PO route and ap@cloudwave.com as the invoice endpoint. They use net 45 and require W-9 + VAT handling.
- Action for Billing Ops: Marissa to own vendor setup (I will open a ticket). Need to attach Redwood W-9 and include vendor tax id in invoice template.
- Action for Product/Integrations: Karthik, they mentioned CSV batch ingest for automation — can you flag if we have a standard CSV export format for invoices or if we'll need to generate one?
- Next customer-facing step: Marcus to send updated invoice spec (with PO field and vendor tax id) + Redwood W-9 and a PO template for CloudWave to issue. Offer a short test invoice to validate ingestion.

I'm including a draft internal timeline: vendor setup & W-9 upload (by 11/18), final invoice spec + CSV sample (by 11/20), send test invoice (by 11/22). If AP confirms ingestion, then schedule first invoice on our normal billing date.

Marissa Cole
Head of Revenue Operations | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com
From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
To: Anita Shah <anita.shah@cloudwave.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 17 Nov 2026 14:45:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Commercial onboarding | billing & procurement acceptance checklist

Thanks, Anita — very helpful. Attaching the files you requested and next steps below.

Files attached: Redwood-Invoice-Specs-v1.pdf (updated with PO field and vendor tax id), Redwood-W9.pdf, CloudWave-PO_Template.docx

Next steps (summary):
- CloudWave: issue PO to ap@cloudwave.com and share PO number when ready (we'll use this for invoice generation).
- Redwood: Marissa will open vendor setup ticket and upload W-9; Billing Ops will generate a test PDF invoice and CSV sample reflecting your required fields by 11/20.
- Both: run a test invoice ingestion to confirm AP acceptance. If CSV ingestion is needed, we'll coordinate a short call with Integration/IT (Karthik) to map columns.

If that timeline works, we'll treat the PO as the formal trigger for moving to reserved capacity (if discussed in contract) and set start-of-billing.

Appreciate the quick turnaround — will follow up after Marissa confirms vendor setup.

Cheers,
Marcus
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marcus.lin@redwood.com

Attachments: Redwood-Invoice-Specs-v1.pdf (updated), Redwood-W9.pdf, CloudWave-PO_Template.docx
